The center-manifold equations force a nonzero quintic reduced coefficient, and the symbolic artifact gives zero residual for the transformed equations, energy identity, leading invariance equations and coefficient. originality.rationale: The strict subthreshold attraction theorem, exact nonzero equilibria and pitchfork terminology are prior work and are excluded from the novelty claim. The inspected sources did not state the equality-case global closure together with the structural vanishing of the cubic center coefficient, fifth-order saturation, or explicit t^{-1/4} critical relaxation. A 1981 review by the original authors and older Russian-language work remain residual coverage risks.
